geometry_format: provinces[].polygons: outer rings only, clockwise, no holes (islands are separate rings; enclaves under 0.001 deg2 are filled). lines.*: open or closed paths.
source: PDOK / Kadaster NL, BRK Bestuurlijke Gebieden
